atAGlance: Canh chua chay is vegetarian sour soup, usually with tamarind, pineapple, tomato, okra, herbs, tofu, and rice.
whatItIs: Canh chua chay is vegetarian sour soup with tamarind, pineapple, tomato, okra, bạc hà stems, tofu, herbs, and vegetable broth.
howToEnjoy: Eat it with rice and taste the sour broth before adding chili. Ask about fish sauce if strict vegetarian seasoning matters.
howLocalsOrder: Order canh chua chay when you want the southern sour-soup flavor without fish. Say không nước mắm and ít cay before the pot or bowl is finished.
worthKnowing: Canh chua is loved for its tamarind sourness and vegetable sweetness; the chay version keeps that bright rhythm with tofu and herbs.
goodToKnow: Ask whether the sour broth uses vegetarian seasoning; fish sauce can appear quietly in mixed kitchens.
travelerCaution: Ask about fish sauce or stock if strict.
